checks.name: manual:Symbolic ABI and self signal disposition

conceptual_peer_summary: Read-only peer independently emphasized guard-only worker waitpid parenthood and controller-loss/partial-handshake races; no tools/source reads/tests/compiler/host edits for that conceptual note. Summary of peer message, not an execution receipt.
implementation_review_conditions: Record and verify descriptor ownership/close facts per process and per inherited copy, not a global numeric-FD close count. Worker must close inherited controller pidfd/unrelated writers while guard keeps its own valid copies.

Implement exact readiness/ARM/ACK state transitions and negative early-controller/worker exit, missing/partial report, EPIPE and deadline edges; enum or ready boolean alone is insufficient evidence of arm.
Every loop and cleanup path must honor inherited deadlines, preserve first failure, report unknown/unreaped outcomes, and never reset remaining budget or signal after the declared cleanup window.

Success parser must recompute PID-birth/nonce/parent bindings, controller poll event, actual signal return, worker pidfd exit and matching waitpid status, guard/controller parent reaps, timing order and close facts from exact typed returned evidence.

Source review must check the particular observed header constants/signatures and trusted toolchain facts. This design review does not supply constants, source freeze, actual execution, success fixtures or a general process-management API.
limits: Independent reasoning and current design JSON bindings only; no proposed source, fixture, compiler, project module, old audit, data, CI raw, host or network operation was executed.
Declared utility hashes are design identities; their bodies were not reread/rehashed by this critique. No current runtime/input capability is proven.

R1 issues are retained as authored review-message summaries; root resolved them in a distinct r2 candidate before source. Acceptance is source-planning permission, not acceptance of unwritten implementation or actual lifecycle outcomes.

Four C roles plus separate observer/bootstrap/toolchain activity must be counted honestly. Owned direct-worker/controller-loss evidence cannot be generalized to arbitrary descendants, guard/coordinator/observer/host loss, physical exclusion, GPU lease, foreign queue restore or model/runtime ABI.

Later source tests/review/latest exact-head CI/integration and separately accepted exact prelaunch are mandatory before fresh host episodes. Each case requires new declared scope/nonce/path/attempt; no fallback/retry/resume/current or old output reuse.

manual_assessments.reason: Exactly4 C fixture roles: coordinator directly owns controller and guard; guard directly owns one fixed forked worker. Python observer/bootstrap and compiler/linker processes are separately counted. No externally supplied PID/executable or worker exec/extra services.

Guard alone waitpid-reaps worker. Coordinator separately pidfd-observes and waitpid-reaps its controller/guard. Inherited controller pidfd supplies liveness/exit observation without conferring waitpid parenthood.

Controller ready packet is validated against own-fork identity before controller pidfd acquisition. Guard publishes its identity then blocks; coordinator owns validated guard pidfd before GUARD_START allows worker fork. Early setup acquisition or handshake failure remains negative.

Worker remains on sole guard control pipe until private identity/nonce and own-fork PID/birth/boot/UID are bound and guard holds worker pidfd. Guard forwards readiness only after checks; partial/missing readiness or pre-readiness controller exit cannot produce success.

NORMAL_ARM is sent only after complete guard/worker readiness. Guard records worker-stop intent and validates live controller/identity/product/deadlines before ACK; coordinator validates ACK before controller orderly quit. Guard owns normal worker exit/reap and coordinator matches controller exit0.

LOSS_ARM follows complete readiness and controller-live checks; exact acknowledged arm precedes deliberate controller exit. Guard must observe controller pidfd exit and revalidate its own/worker identity/product/time before one fixed symbolic worker pidfd signal. Setup controller death is a negative, not a successful loss case.

All target PIDs derive from the current fixture fork results/private role handshake; no free PID or kill(PID) fallback. Anchored pidfd preserves target association under trusted source. Guard signals only its newly created worker, no retry, and actual poll/wait outcomes must confirm expected SIGKILL termination.

Every role closes unused pipe/controller/report FDs; guard drops controller-control writer before worker creation, worker drops inherited unrelated writers/descriptors. Nonblocking private packets are bounded below PIPE_BUF and validate role/magic/nonce/exact lengths with bounded accumulation.

Guard writes bounded terminal facts before exit. Coordinator drains with finite deadline before blocking final reap, avoiding pipe-backpressure deadlock; matched controller/guard wait statuses do not substitute for worker facts, which only guard can reap.

All roles inherit coordinator t0 before pipe/fork. Shared deadlines are work+5, owned signal/exit/reap cleanup+8, guard terminal+10, worker self+12, coordinator+14; per-read resets forbidden. Outer direct-child30+2 timeout is larger and separately scoped. Every poll/read/write/WNOHANG step recomputes finite nonreverse remaining budget.

Clock/source/identity/handshake errors retain first typed failure, separately recording cleanup outcomes/unknowns. Invalid ownership prevents signal. Bounded worker self-expiry is a code path, not observed asynchronous recovery; coordinator/guard/observer/host loss and generalized descendant restoration remain outside scope.

Every normal handled acquired pidfd copy closes at most once with immediate errno and no signal/close retry. Success uses immediate F_GETFD/EBADF with no intervening descriptor opening; first failure remains distinct from later cleanup facts.

C roles share reviewed forked product mapping. Product stat identity is checked before release/signal; Python binds exact captured inputs/artifacts before compile/runtime and postruntime. fstat/ctime is explicitly not continuous source-byte or full mapped-code authentication; trusted compiler/loader/procfs/filesystem assumptions remain visible.

manual_assessments.area: Symbolic ABI and self signal disposition
manual_assessments.reason: System-header SYS_pidfd_open/SYS_pidfd_send_signal, fixed flags0/NULL/SIGKILL, explicit syscall operand casts and representability assertions are reviewed before use. No syscall/provider/architecture guessing or old API shim. Ignoring SIGPIPE is disclosed only as current-product disposition for handled EPIPE, not a foreign signal.

New observer executes captured immutable helper/toolchain/selfcheck utility bodies in private nonmain namespaces and calls only backend/pure ELF/link parsers, never old observe/CLI/product/native/science. Seven-file closure and five deployed Git sources+fresh request are correctly distinct; --execute stays rejected before request/context/compiler/Torch.

Design requires duplicate/nonfinite/type, foreign PID/PPID/birth/UID/boot/nonce/product, wrong wait owner/status, early exit/partial readiness/missing terminal report, clock/timeouts and forged normal/loss negatives. Injected helper/backend seams are labeled CPU fixtures.

Separate fresh normal and loss fixtures actually compile/link/run dedicated C; normal worker must exit0 and loss worker must have actual single owned signal plus matched WIFSIGNALED/SIGKILL poll/wait facts. Skip only nonLinux; missing declared Linux prerequisites fail. No ready boolean or injected model/GPU substitution suffices.

Current acceptance permits only minimal source work. Independent source/meaningful tests/commit/push/attached PR/latest exact CI/main integration precede any separately declared host case/nonce/path/attempt/exact prelaunch. No current request/nonce/host action, old consumed replay, resource rights, model ABI, promotion or restoration claim is supplied.
